A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DiffATD work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: v1 reports original target-discovery experiments across imaging and species-distribution datasets, together with ablations, robustness tests, and computational measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds DOTA results for UCB and an ImageNet-trained diffusion prior.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–2, belief construction, exploration/exploitation scores, and online reward-model training are retained. The ImageNet prior is tested as an ablation of the existing method. Specifying previously unspecified patch dimensions does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: v2 Appendix Q introduces ImageNet as the training domain of an alternative prior evaluated on DOTA. The existing DOTA, iNaturalist, skin, chest X-ray, CelebA, and MNIST tasks remain; moving chest X-ray results into the main text does not add coverage.

E2.justification: v2 Table 18 adds UCB to the DOTA comparisons; v1 evaluated UCB only on MNIST. The MNIST UCB and epsilon-greedy comparisons remain unchanged. GPT-4o, Gemini, and SAM/FullSEG comparisons already existed in v1.

E3.justification: Appendix Q adds an evaluation contrasting ImageNet-trained and DOTA-trained prior models on DOTA at budgets 250 and 300. This introduces an additional model condition without revising the retained experiments' metrics or stated settings. The newly specified 4×4 patches are disclosure rather than an established protocol change.

E4.justification: New Appendix Q and Table 20 test sensitivity to the prior's training domain. v1 lacked this ablation. Existing exploration-weight sensitivity, noisy-observation tests, scalability analyses, and qualitative case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report five independent trials and identical uncertainty entries for DOTA and CelebA in Tables 15–16, relocated from Appendix S to Appendix L. The added comparisons introduce no new uncertainty-reporting practice, seed information, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: v2 Table 18 adds UCB SR values of 0.1132, 0.2487, and 0.2146 on DOTA at budgets 200, 250, and 300. Table 20 adds ImageNet-prior scores of 0.5143 and 0.6391, versus DOTA-prior scores of 0.6379 and 0.7309 at budgets 250 and 300. Matched pre-existing results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Proposition 1, Theorems 1–3, and their mathematical derivations are retained. v1 Appendices A–D become v2 Sections A.1–A.4 with corrected heading numbers. The new notation table summarizes existing symbols rather than introducing new mathematical content.

C1.justification: The central claims about discovery without prior task-specific labeled training, interpretable sampling, and empirical effectiveness are retained, as is the conclusion. Naming species discovery in the abstract and contribution list foregrounds an application already evaluated in v1.

C2.justification: v2 Appendices Q and S explicitly identify dependence on a strong domain-specific prior and explain how data scarcity in rare-species or rare-disease applications can restrict applicability. They propose weak- or no-prior settings as future work. v1 described pretraining but did not state this limitation.

D1.justification: v2 Section 6 provides a link and states that code and models are publicly available, whereas v1 only promised release. Appendix E.2 specifies 4×4 patches where v1 Appendix K used unspecified x×y dimensions. Other implementation details remain unchanged; v2's appendix still retains the future-release wording.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and the same 35 cited works are retained after matching reordered references. Moving the chest X-ray experiment changes citation order without adding literature or revising research positioning.

P1.justification: Document organization is substantially revised: separate appendix proofs, benchmark reports, and implementation sections are grouped into subsections, a contents overview is added, and chest X-ray and VLM discussions move into Section 6. A notation guide, acknowledgements, and limitations section are added, although most existing prose is retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds the DOTA UCB, prior-ablation, and notation tables; reformats Figure 1; resizes several figures; and moves the chest X-ray and VLM table/figure pairs into the main text. Most visual content and table structures are retained, with additional highlighting and layout adjustments.

improvement.justification: The prior ablation and explicit limitations in Appendices Q and S clarify an important applicability boundary. The DOTA UCB comparison, patch-size disclosure, and code/model link provide further modest benefits. These gains outweigh the new contents page's incorrect page references and section labels, although those navigation errors and stale release wording reduce the revision's polish.
